d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a centered part frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow light-blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white and deep purple miko-style outfit featuring wide sleeves, gold trim, and thigh-high white stockings with black sandals. Golden branching horns protrude from the head, while a massive, coiled white serpent with glowing cyan eyes and a luminous maw looms behind. BODY COLOR: white
